note: Crypt groups admitted from OUTSIDE the V5 sets (docs/pool-widening-design.md).
Vampires only — never Imbued, who are a different card type the engine
has no model for. Library cards are NEVER widened by this file: an
unimplemented library card makes a whole deck unplayable, while an
unimplemented crypt ability is merely reported as inert. That asymmetry
is the whole reason this file exists.
A deck's crypt may only use one group or two CONSECUTIVE groups
(p. 4/6), and that rule is enforced by cryptGroupProblem() in
NO PARTIAL CARDS. A widened vampire is admitted only when it is
WHOLE: its ability is implemented, or it prints no ability at all.
The builder enforces that regardless of what this file says, so
opening a group here does not admit a card whose text does nothing.
That is what makes widening a pipeline that follows the card waves
instead of running ahead of them. docs/pool-widening-design.md §0
Empty list = no widening at all, and the registry is byte-identical to
a V5-only build. It is empty now because the 2026-09-08 widening was
rolled back: it had admitted 1,104 vampires with inert abilities.
